source_report: reference to the prior report this was transcribed from
_instructions: One file per previously reviewed policy. `policy` is a path relative to this file or to the repository root; keep client documents outside the repository and point at them.

`profile` names a file in data/profiles. Create one per entity with `python3 -m pfia profile init` and answer every question before benchmarking - an unanswered question makes controls unresolved, which the harness reports separately rather than counting as disagreement.

`findings` maps control_id to the verdict the reviewer reached. Use the reviewer's own words; the harness maps Pass/Fail/Partial/Not Found/N/A onto the register vocabulary. Record only controls the prior review actually addressed - leave the rest out rather than guessing, since a guessed CONFORMING is indistinguishable from a real one.

`unmapped_findings` is for anything the reviewer raised that no control in the register could have produced. This is the most valuable field in the file: it measures register coverage depth, which no automated check can.

unmapped_findings.summary: Pool monthly reporting duties are not addressed anywhere in the policy; the register has one pool control and does not test this.
